purpose: Directly accept or reject a one-frame nonrecursive event hold as the missing moving-flash temporal coverage mechanism.
invariant: Benchmark architecture 10 only; production architecture 0 remained unchanged and the hold stored only the previous frame's event strength.
primary_gate: moving clear-to-5% <=70 ms; moving-flash reduction >=0.45; perceptual minimum reduction >=0.70; WCAG SC 2.3.1 and 2.3.2 pass
interpretation: Mode 10 was numerically identical to mode 8 on every reported gate metric, so a one-frame event hold did not touch the missing moving-flash transition coverage. Source review also showed the carryover was gated by same-screen stableSourceGate, which naturally rejects translating surfaces. The next candidate therefore targets the underlying geometry problem directly: infer a validated motion vector for textureless moving interiors, then measure intrinsic raw-source change at that transported surface without adding display memory.
evidence_serialization: Repository copies are UTF-8 LF JSON serializations of the artifact JSON values.
